route_title: Localized reinitialization of MgF2/HfO2 chirped stack with frozen front section
compilation_rationale: Compiles a 20-layer HfO2/MgF2 planar stack on fused silica with fixed first nine layers and optimized remaining eleven within ±3 nm bounds. Coherent smatrix solver covers the 255–1100 nm sweep. Three transmittance targets exactly score the specified bands at normal incidence, fulfilling all stated conditions without inventing results.
